# ArchiVinci

> > ArchiVinci is an AI-powered architectural rendering platform enabling 600k+ users to generate photorealistic designs for interiors, exteriors, and urban planning.

ArchiVinci provides a comprehensive suite of AI tools for architects, designers, and real estate professionals to create presentation-ready renderings, stage properties, and conceptualize designs using generative AI. The platform combines sketch-to-render capabilities, virtual staging, and style transfer technology to streamline the architectural visualization workflow.
